tasks.short: Assess the hazard and decide the message, write the public statement, check it, send it to media and partners, answer journalists' calls, and brief health professionals and authorities.

steps.what: Public health physician assesses the potential health hazard and decides the message
Public health physician writes the public statement on hazards and possible interventions

loop.input: The national guideline text for the hazard and the case facts decided in s1.
loop.output: A draft public statement and a short version for partners.
loop.check: Every advice sentence must cite a guideline paragraph and every number must match the case facts, or it is dropped; the physician edits every text.
loop.stop: One draft per statement; if rejected, the physician writes it.
loop.why_not_simpler: Each incident needs its own wording; a fixed template reads as generic.

steps.what: Public health physician checks the final statement
Public health physician e-mails the statement to the media and partners
Public health physician answers journalists' and the public's questions by phone
Public health physician briefs other health care professionals and health authorities

tasks.design: A bounded step drafts the public statement and a partner version from the national guideline and the case facts; sentences without a guideline paragraph or with numbers that do not match are dropped, and the physician edits every text. Once checked, the statement goes to the media and partner list from the mailing tool ({EMAIL}). Assessing the hazard, answering journalists and briefing professionals stay with the physician.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each statement was written from scratch under time pressure.
tasks.enabler_now: Language models draft text that can be checked against guideline paragraphs.
tasks.still_hard: New hazards have no guideline text yet.
tasks.human_edge: Calming a worried town without playing down a real risk.
tasks.altitude: The physician edits statements instead of writing from scratch.

evidence.claim: Language models can draft text whose sentences can be checked against cited guideline paragraphs.
AI-generated text published on matters of public interest must be disclosed unless a person reviews it and takes editorial responsibility.

assumptions: Boundary: from the hazard signal to professionals briefed; control measures are outside.
Input contract: national guideline texts available; fallback is writing from scratch.
The physician checks every statement before it goes out.
Journalists' and partners' time does not change.
research_questions: How much of each drafted statement is kept?

already_counted.description: Public health physician edits drafted statements.

incremental.description: Public health physician keeps the media and partner list current.

approvals.approved_version: The statement as checked by the physician in s3.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: a rare new hazard with no guideline text; high: recurring hazards such as heat or outbreaks with set guidelines.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare training content, teach sessions on preventive medicine, arrange sessions and sign-ups, and record attendance for accreditation.

steps.what: Public health physician prepares training content on preventive medicine issues
Public health physician arranges sessions and sign-ups by e-mail
Public health physician teaches or trains medical staff
Public health physician records attendance for accreditation on paper lists

tasks.design: Training content is kept in a shared slide and case library by topic ({DOCS}) and adapted per group. Sessions run as courses in the learning system ({LMS}), where staff enrol themselves and attendance is recorded by QR sign-in for accreditation, so sign-ups and paper lists are not handled by e-mail. Teaching stays with the physician.
tasks.previous_blocker: Content was rebuilt per session and sign-ups and attendance handled by e-mail and paper.
tasks.enabler_now: Learning systems take enrolments and record attendance.
tasks.still_hard: Accreditation bodies want their own attendance format.
tasks.human_edge: Making prevention matter to busy clinicians.

evidence.claim: Learning systems take self-enrolment and record attendance by QR sign-in.

assumptions: Boundary: from the training need to attendance recorded; accreditation decisions are outside.
Input contract: courses set up in the learning system; fallback is e-mail and paper.
Staff enrol themselves in about the time an e-mail took.

incremental.description: Public health physician sends attendance in the accreditation body's format.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: one-off sessions on new topics; high: repeated sessions with set content.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Meet partners to agree joint actions, plan the meetings, keep the partner action list and chase updates, and write meeting notes and agreements.

steps.what: Public health physician coordinates health care institutions, social service agencies and public safety workers in partner meetings
Public health physician plans partner meetings by e-mail
Public health physician keeps the partner action list in a spreadsheet and chases updates
Public health physician writes meeting notes and agreements

tasks.design: Partner meetings are planned with a calendar poll ({CALENDAR}). Agreed actions sit on a shared action board ({PROJECT}) that each partner updates for its own actions, so the physician does not keep a spreadsheet and chase updates by e-mail. Notes and agreements are written in a shared document during the meeting. Coordinating partners stays with the physician.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actions were tracked in a spreadsheet and updates chased by e-mail.
tasks.enabler_now: Shared action boards and calendar polls work across organisations.
tasks.still_hard: Some partners do not update the board.
tasks.human_edge: Getting the police and care providers to share responsibility.

reach.learn: Whether everyone sees the same action list.

evidence.claim: Shared action boards and calendar polls can be used across organisations.

assumptions: Boundary: from the community issue to notes written; funding decisions are outside.
Input contract: partners have board access; fallback is the spreadsheet.
Partners update their own actions in about the time replying to e-mails took.
No personal data of residents go on the board.
research_questions: Are joint actions completed on time more often?

incremental.description: Public health physician reminds partners who do not update the board.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: few partners who rarely use the board; high: large networks that keep the board current.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Gather data and literature, analyse the problem, decide recommendations, write the report, check it, and send it to the municipality.

steps.what: Public health physician gathers data and literature for preventive health reports
Public health physician analyses the problem in spreadsheets
Public health physician weighs alternative solutions and decides recommendations
Public health physician writes the report with problem description and analyses

loop.input: The physician's outline, analysis tables and decided recommendations, and the selected literature.
loop.check: Every number must match the analysis tables and every citation must resolve to a DOI or catalogue record, or it is dropped; recommendations are copied only from s3; the physician edits every section.
loop.stop: One draft per section; if rejected, the physician writes it.
loop.why_not_simpler: Each report argues a different problem; a template gives only the structure.

steps.what: Public health physician checks the final report
Public health physician e-mails the report to the municipality

tasks.design: A health dashboard ({BI}) gives the standard figures for the area, and a literature search over citation databases suggests sources that must resolve by DOI, so data and literature are not gathered by hand. Standard analyses run as versioned scripts. A bounded step drafts report sections from the physician's outline, tables and decided recommendations; numbers and citations are checked, and the physician edits every section. Once checked, the report goes to the municipality through the secure exchange.
tasks.previous_blocker: Data and literature were gathered by hand and reports written from scratch.
tasks.enabler_now: Dashboards hold area figures; language models draft sections that can be checked against tables.
tasks.human_edge: Choosing the recommendation the council can actually carry out.
tasks.altitude: The physician decides and edits instead of compiling.

reach.learn: Whether reports arrive in time for decisions.

evidence.claim: Language models can draft report sections that can be checked against tables and resolving citations.
Health data are special category data; reports use aggregated figures.

assumptions: Boundary: from the report request to the report sent; council decisions are outside.
Input contract: area figures on the dashboard; fallback is gathering by hand.
The physician decides every recommendation and checks every report.
Council staff read reports as before.
research_questions: How much of each drafted section is kept?

already_counted.description: Public health physician edits drafted sections.

incremental.description: Public health physician maintains the analysis scripts.

approvals.approved_version: The report as checked by the physician in s5.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: a one-off report on a new local problem; high: a yearly report with set figures and structure.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The public health physician keeps assessing hazards, teaching, coordinating partners and deciding recommendations; statements and reports from scratch, e-mail scheduling and spreadsheet tracking shrink.
role.ambitious_version: A physician with more time for prevention.
